assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval Stoneshard mod N13 REVIEW pixel environment. assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Stoneshard mod N14 pixel-art REVIEW four-keyframe action board, exactly FOUR equal panels in one horizontal row on flat neutral grey background. Same anonymous adult mountain maintenance worker, brown work cap, short grey beard, dull teal tunic, leather apron, brown boots; same three-quarter top-down game-sprite camera, identical wooden waist-high workbench and inert practice bracket in EVERY panel, identical scale and floor anchor. Story action: ordinary mechanical tool practice, NOT operation of core device. Frame1 worker points to mounted clamp on left of bracket with both jaws open. Frame2 worker closes insulated clamp around inert dull iron rod. Frame3 worker keeps clamp mounted and uses long disconnect lever on right to create visible gap in rod. Frame4 worker inserts short locking pin into bracket to retain gap, hands away. Constant LEFT-to-RIGHT orientation, no swapping handedness, no people connected, no liquid, no crystals, no electrical spark, no magical glow. Three tools mechanically distinct, no more than two arms per person. Chunky coarse pixel clusters ~40 logical pixels for figure, solid muted earth/grey/teal palette, upper-left light. No captions, numbering, borders, rendered text or props outside cells. It is an action study not engine-ready animation and no safety certification.
